input.source_text: Float64.infinity getter replacement, then add a setter that records its argument

applicability.reason: Blocked by the recorded IRIS-V1-RUNTIME-V103 defect, not by a native boundary. The POSITIVE half is fully observable: `open class Float64 { public override property fun infinity() { :replaced } }` answers `:replaced`, and an added setter records its argument. The negative half cannot be observed at all, because C004 makes Float64 identity-less and META-C112 requires raw ivar reflection to refuse a value receiver, so `list_ivars(1.0f64)` is UnsupportedConstruct by design. Re-authoring the row to assert only the observable half was offered to the owner and declined in favour of an honest failure; see docs/spec-defects-v1.md.

expect.status: Replaced getter result is observed; setter records its argument without creating implicit backing storage.
